source: CRON 20261014: FY2026 column added from Hyprop Investments Limited audited consolidated and separate annual financial statements for the year ended 30 June 2026 (statements of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, page 23; DOCUSIGN-signed, board-approved 8 September 2026), group column, printed in thousands of rand and stored here as absolute rand: Revenue 5,111,663; property expenses 2,162,840; other operating income 3,275; other operating expenses 192,416; net foreign exchange loss 101; changes in ECL on trade receivables 6,043; operating income 2,753,538; interest income 62,691; interest expense 954,882; profit before taxation 3,866,952; taxation 228,589; profit for the year 3,638,363 (attributable to shareholders 3,640,867 less non-controlling interests 2,504). Rows follow this file's existing conventions: Cost of Sales is the printed property expenses, Operating Profit (EBIT) is the printed operating income, Net Finance Costs is the printed interest expense, and Operating Expenses is stated so that gross profit less operating expenses reproduces the printed operating income exactly (192,416 other operating expenses less 3,275 other operating income plus 101 net foreign exchange loss plus 6,043 changes in ECLs on trade receivables). Gates tie: 5,111,663 less 2,162,840 equals 2,948,823 gross profit; 2,948,823 less 195,285 equals 2,753,538 operating income; 3,866,952 less 228,589 equals 3,638,363 profit for the year. EPS is the audited basic earnings per share of 902.9 cents (diluted 899.7 cents), stated in rand as 9.029. Gross, operating and net margin are computed from this column. ROE, ROA and Debt to Equity are left empty for FY2026 because no FY2026 balance sheet inputs were read in this pass. | Yahoo Finance
